referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This process models 1 meter of sewer system infrastructure with polymer concrete pipe, DN 800, profile 2A, according to SIA 190. Trench depth: 3 meters. This process includes the production phase (A1–A3), the construction phase (A4–A5) as well as deconstruction phase (C1), transport phase (C2), treatment/recycling phase (C3), and final disposal phase (C4) for one meter of sewer system with polymer concrete pipe.

exchange.generalComment: (2,2,1,1,3,4,BU:3); 1 meter of installed sewer infrastructure with polymer concrete pipe, DN 800, profile 2A according to SIA 190. Trench depth: 3 meters. This process includes the production phase (A1–A3) and the construction phase (A4–A5) for one linear meter of installed polymer concrete pipe, including trench excavation and backfilling.; Construction method according to SIA 190, material parameters based on competence centre (cc) Kanalisation, VSA Arbeitsgruppe Materialwahl, transport distances estimated average distances in Switzerland. Construction and use of building machines based on "Maschinenstunden" (Machine hours) standard analysis in the TB-Viewer of the Schweizerischer Baumeisterverband (Swiss Contractors Association)

exchange.generalComment: (2,2,1,1,3,2,BU:3); Deconstruction and end-of-life treatment for 1 meter of installed sewer infrastructure with polymer concrete pipe, DN 800, profile 2A according to SIA 190. Trench depth: 3 meters. This process includes the deconstruction phase (C1), transport phase (C2), treatment/recycling phase (C3), and final disposal phase (C4).; Amount of construction materials being deconstructed based on process for similar sewer system typ, stages A1-A5, and according to SIA 190 as well as competence centre (cc) Kanalisation, VSA Arbeitsgruppe Materialwahl. Transport distances representing estimated average distances in Switzerland. Deconstruction and use of building machines based on "Maschinenstunden" (Machine hours) standard analysis in the TB-Viewer of the Schweizerischer Baumeisterverband (Swiss Contractors Association)
